Team,

- Last activity > 180 days
- Close date pushed 2+ times without new milestone or customer sign-off
- No primary contact in the last 90 days

Attachment: [stale-opps-report.csv (CSV, 48KB)]

1) CLAIM the row in SF and update stage/close date with a short note on next step, or

If no action by EOD Wed I will move flagged rows into the quarterly holdlist so they don’t distort the committed roll-up. Call out any exceptions you want preserved and I’ll leave them out of the bulk move.

For context: Finance wants >95% forecast hygiene for the commit bucket ahead of Q3 planning. This is a small, surgical sweep — aim for fast decisions, not long writeups.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn here.
